The theory applied is Natural Semantic Metalanguage (NSM) with two at once approaches, namely mapping and explication. The results showed that there is something good happened, represented by the lexicons: demen, kendel, and l\u00e9dang, and something bad happened: sebet, inguh, and gedeg.
